mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET display_name = #{displayName}, last_attendance_date = #{lastAttendanceDate}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_serial_counters (region_code, next_seq) VALUES (#{regionCode}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region_code = region_code
mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.emp_no, e.region_code, e.agency_key, e.match_name, e.display_name, e.status, e.first_created_at, e.last_attendance_date, e.last_seen_at, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM employees e
ORDER BY e.last_attendance_date DESC, e.emp_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT region_code AS value, region_code AS label FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(prompt_country)) AS region_code FROM tasks WHERE prompt_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(prompt_country) != '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT region_code FROM employees WHERE region_code IS NOT NULL AND region_code != '' ) t WHERE region_code IS NOT NULL AND region_code != '' ORDER BY region_code LIMIT 200
